# Acme pricing guide

Acme has two plans. The Starter plan costs $19 per month. The Team plan costs $49 per month.

## Billing

Plans are billed monthly by default. Annual billing gives a 20% discount on the Team plan.
The annual discount does not apply to the Starter plan.

## Definitions

A workspace is one billing account that holds one or more projects.

## Worked example

Example: a Team plan on annual billing costs $470.40 per year (12 × $49.00 × 0.8).
